type: Lockstitch sewing machine (平缝机) controller with stepper motor backstitch and servo presser foot lift
source: A4C电控使用说明书V0.1_20250120（中文).pdf (V0.1, 2025-01-20, Chinese/English, 15 pages)
note: A4C is a lockstitch machine controller — fundamentally different from overlock controllers (C5/C7-A/C5C). Key features: (1) Stepper motor for backstitch positioning and stitch length control (Err-21 to Err-29 are stepper motor errors); (2) Servo-driven presser foot lift with stepper (P173/P174/P175 height adjustment); (3) Three sewing modes: Free sew, W sew, Multi-section sew (vs overlock's full auto/semi-auto/full computer); (4) Thread clamp function (P32/P33/P35 and dedicated clamping angle parameters P248-P270); (5) Bird's nest prevention (P256-P270); (6) Pattern sewing and piecework counter mode; (7) 15 buttons on panel. No IoT. Parameter numbering is completely different from C5/C7-A — uses P00-P304 with non-sequential numbering. Monitoring entered via P + presser foot lifter (not P + right). Factory reset via long press Reset button.

buttons.name: Stitch length adjustment key
buttons.description: Press + or - to increase or decrease stitch length in idle state

buttons.name: Front hardening key
buttons.description: Cycles: front solid joint → front double solid joint → close cycle. LCD icon lights. Select to set number of pins in segment A and B.

buttons.name: Rear hardening key
buttons.description: Cycles: after solid seam → After double solid seam → close. LCD icon lights. Select to set pins in segment C and D.

buttons.name: Clamping/Needle position section function
buttons.description: Short press: toggle thread clamping on/off (LCD thread tension icon). When bird's nest is opened, thread clamping is forced on and key is invalid. Long press: switch up/down needle stop position.

buttons.name: Press foot lift key
buttons.description: Short press: cycle through presser foot lifting modes (presser foot lifting on → midway presser foot lifting on → presser foot lifting on after thread trimming → midway presser foot lifting off → presser foot lifting off after trimming → presser foot lifting off → presser foot lifting off). Long press: turn on/off presser foot lift.

buttons.name: Trimmer key
buttons.description: Short press: switch automatic thread trimming function on/off

buttons.name: Mode switch key
buttons.description: Short press: cycle working mode — free sew → W sew → multi-section sew

buttons.name: Pattern sew / piecework interface key
buttons.description: Short press: enter pattern sew mode; in pattern sew mode, short press switches between pattern sew interface and pattern sew setting interface. Long press + P: enter or exit piece counting mode.

buttons.name: Reset key
buttons.description: Long press to return to factory setting

parameterEntry.userParams: Press P to enter parameter mode. Press Left or Right to move selection (number flashes). Press Up or Down to modify value. Press P to save. If not modified, press P to log out. If modified, save first then press P to exit.
parameterEntry.technicianParams: Press P and turn on the machine to enter technician parameter mode. Same navigation as user params.
parameterEntry.monitoring: Press P + press foot lifter key to enter monitoring mode. Press up/down to adjust parameter. Press P to log out. If monitoring item is 24/25/26/28: press P to save as corresponding parameter (shows OK if successful). Press P briefly to exit monitoring mode.
parameterEntry.speedAdjust: Press Up or Down keys to adjust speed. Up=fast adjustment, Down=slow. Each step is 50 RPM. Press and hold for continuous.
parameterEntry.factoryReset: Press and hold Reset key for a long time to restore factory settings.
parameterEntry.pieceworkMode: Long press Pattern sew key + P to enter/exit piece counting mode.
parameterEntry.quickParamAdjust: Press stitch length + key to enter Quick Parameter Adjustment Mode. Press Up or Down to switch options. Options: '0' (stepper zero calibration), '4' (4.0mm forward sew stitch length, calibrate to 3.9-4.1mm), '-4' (4.0mm reverse overlap), '5' (5.0mm forward, calibrate 4.8-5.2mm), '-5' (5.0mm reverse overlap), '-3' (3.0mm reverse overlap), '-2' (2.0mm reverse overlap), 'L' (presser foot height, calibrate to 1mm high). Speed auto changes to 200 RPM when adjusting. Press P to save.
parameterEntry.upperNeedleStop: Enter monitoring item M24, adjust handwheel to upper needle stop position (parameter changes with handwheel). Long press button to save the parameter. Lower needle position auto-adjusts.

troubleshooting.cause: Stepper motor needs calibration for accurate stitch length
troubleshooting.solution: Press stitch length + key to enter Quick Parameter Adjustment Mode. Select option '0'. Place a piece of paper on the needle plate. Step pedal to bottom to perform empty sew without thread. Check if needle operates in hole. Adjust value of option '0' and press P to save.

troubleshooting.issue: Stitch length not matching expected value
troubleshooting.cause: Stepper motor stitch length compensation needs adjustment
troubleshooting.solution: Enter Quick Param Mode (stitch length + key). Select '4' for 4.0mm forward, '-4' for 4.0mm reverse, '5' for 5.0mm forward. Sew 10 stitches at 200 RPM, measure actual length. Increase range value if stitch too small, decrease if too large. Press P to save.

troubleshooting.issue: Bird's nest thread buildup at sew start
troubleshooting.cause: Thread clamp not engaging properly or bird's nest prevention not enabled
troubleshooting.solution: Enable P35=1 (thread clamp on) and P256=1 (less bird's nest). Configure P257 (starting angle 160), P258 (duration 15). Check thread clamp function via panel key 4.

troubleshooting.issue: Presser foot not lifting to correct height
troubleshooting.solution: Use Quick Param Mode option 'L' (press stitch length + key, select L). With gauge block, set suitable value. P175 is fine correction (correct to 1mm high). P173 is pause height; P174 is height after trimming.
